title: A Benchmark for Interpretability Methods in Deep Neural Networks (ROAR)
authors: Sara Hooker; Dumitru Erhan; Pieter-Jan Kindermans; Been Kim
research_question: How can feature importance methods be evaluated without distribution shift confounds?
experimental_method: Remove and Retrain (ROAR): masking top features and retraining from scratch
principal_findings: Masking features on a frozen model creates out-of-distribution artifacts; retraining is needed for true attribution.
